title: Astronomical Unit and Nearby Stars Visualization
full_prompt: Write a ManimGL script that visualizes the concept of an Astronomical Unit (A.U.) and nearby stars. Create a 3D scene using InteractiveScene. Define helper functions to generate a textured Sun (using Sphere and TexturedSurface with custom glow effects), a textured Earth, and a celestial sphere background. In the main scene, set up the Sun at the center, a circular orbit of radius 3.5, and a glowing dot representing Earth. Draw a line from the Sun to the Earth's orbit representing 1 Astronomical Unit, labeled with the text 'Astronomical\nUnit'. Animate the orbit's rotation while fading in the line and label. Next, transform the 'Astronomical Unit' label into 'A.U.' using a character-by-character ReplacementTransform. Finally, reorient the camera frame to shift the view to the side, preparing for a transition to a larger cosmic scale.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Using ManimCE camera controls instead of ManimGL frame.animate.reorient
common_failure_modes.note: ManimGL uses self.frame for camera manipulation, which is incompatible with ManimCE's self.camera.
The code relies on specific textures like 'SunTexture' and 'hiptyc_2020_8k'. If missing, fallback colors or placeholders should be used.
f_always is a ManimGL-specific shorthand for adding continuous updaters. Standard add_updater must be used if translating to CE.
